Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**THE RECORD BREAKER**

FADE IN:

INT. WORLD RECORD OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and camera crews. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Pleasure To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live, Held By The Incomparable Jasper Jenkins!

Jasper Steps Up To The Microphone, A Beaming Smile On His Face.

JASPER
Thank You, Thank You. I Am Truly Honored To Receive This Record.

The Crowd Erupts In Cheers And Applause As Jasper Accepts The Plaque.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper Lies In Bed, The Plaque Displayed On His Nightstand. He Looks Up At The Ceiling, A Faraway Look In His Eyes.

JASPER (V.O)
I Remember Reading About This Theory Online, Back In My Youth. Quantum Immortality. The Idea That Our Universe Is A Simulation, And We Are All Just Trapped In A Never-Ending Loop Of Reality.

Jasper's Voice Becomes More Urgent, His Words Spilling Out In A Rush.

JASPER (V.O)
It Said That If We Were Trapped In A Simulation, Then Every Time We Died, The Simulation Would Restart, And We Would Be Reborn. But What If We Could Cheat Death? What If We Could Break Free From The Simulation?

Jasper's Voice Drops To A Whisper, His Eyes Wide With Fear.

JASPER (V.O)
What If I'm Not Really Dead? What If I'm Just... Restarting?

Jasper's Body Begins To Shake, His Eyes Rolling Back In His Head. He Starts To Crawl Out Of Bed, His Hands Reaching Out Like Tentacles.

JASPER (V.O)
I Have To Get Out Of Here. I Have To Find The Truth.

The Camera Zooms In On Jasper's Face, His Eyes Wild And Unhinged.

JASPER (V.O)
I Will Find The Answer. I Will Break Free From The Simulation.

Jasper's Body Continues To Shake, His Voice Becoming A Frenzied Chant.

JASPER (V.O)
I AM NOT DEAD. I AM NOT DEAD. I AM NOT DEAD.

The Camera Zooms Out, Showing Jasper's Bedroom In Chaos. The Plaque Falls To The Floor, Broken Into Pieces.

FADE TO BLACK.

**THE END**
